title: ScottyBoat Rentals
specs: Explore St. Andrews Bay and anchor near Shell Island
Opportunity to see dolphins, manatees, and various fish species
Must be at least 18 years old to rent a boat
If born after January 1, 1988, must have a valid temporary boaters certificate
No boating experience required; full instructions and safety test provided
Anyone over 15 years old who plans to fish must have a Florida Fishing License
Pontoon boats hold up to 10 people
includes: USCG Safety Gear including anchor, ladder, life jackets (infant to adult)
Boat registration, map/flag warning, whistle or horn, Bimini or T-Top for shade
gap: Prices not stated for any rentals
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats or center console boats to explore St. Andrews Bay and nearby waters at their own pace. Pontoon boats seat up to 10 people and are stable and easy to operate, suitable for groups and rougher waters. Center consoles are equipped for fishing and cruising, with safety gear and navigation aids provided.
extraNote: Reservations strongly encouraged to ensure availability · Alcohol allowed but must have a designated driver; no grills allowed on boats · East end of Hathaway Bridge (Highway 98), turn South at Shell Island Cruise
